title: Images: srcDark / .dark pairing for light and dark article images
description: Ryan 2026-11-01: automatic light/dark support for article images. ::image{srcDark} (or figure.dark.png next to figure.png) renders light and dark variants; stock CSS follows data-theme on the root, OS preference as fallback. Docs: markus-content-markup.md, how-a-publish-flows.md. Specs: features_backend/image-dark-variant.feature.
